CRITERION: The study analyzes educational indicators, educational systems, or educational change.
JUSTIFICATION: Direct relevance to the research question.

CRITERION: The study uses longitudinal, panel, dynamic, time-series, system-dynamics, or differential-equation methods.
The study includes access, exclusion, completion, attainment, literacy, education quality, teachers, infrastructure, or educational financing.
JUSTIFICATION: Connects the literature with the UIS indicators.

CRITERION: The study reports enough methodological detail to evaluate data, model, sample, and findings.
Peer-reviewed studies, authoritative institutional reports, methodological books, or official data documentation.
Publication available in English or Spanish.
JUSTIFICATION: Languages that can be assessed consistently.

CRITERION: The study concerns classroom teaching only and does not analyze system-level educational change.
JUSTIFICATION: Outside the system and indicator level.

CRITERION: Opinion pieces, promotional material, or documents without identifiable methods or sources.
Duplicate publication or duplicate database record.
JUSTIFICATION: Each study must be counted once.

CRITERION: The study reports only a cross-sectional description without temporal, comparative, or methodological relevance.
Full text cannot be obtained after reasonable institutional and author searches.
The source, sample, indicators, or estimation procedure cannot be determined.
